text:
ashwin: Heads up — after pushing the 550.x driver + CUDA 12.1 image to the us-west1-gpu pool, ~8 nodes entered an initramfs/rescue drop and failed to boot the OS. Saw DKMS failures during dracut rebuild. Rolling back to 535 fixed 3 of them but 5 are still looping.

maria: which instance types + GPUs?

ashwin: a mix of A100 and A10G VMs, kernel 5.15.0-89-generic on our custom image. Logs show nvidia module missing symbols + dkms exit code 10.

kai: could be Secure Boot/module signing mismatch. Any 'modinfo nvidia' or 'dmesg' hints about signature?

ashwin: here's the tail of /var/lib/dkms/nvidia/550.10/build/make.log and kernel messages:

```
/var/lib/dkms/nvidia/550.10/build/make.log: error: could not find kernel headers for kernel 5.15.0-89-generic
DKMS: install completed, but with warnings.
/sbin/mkinitramfs: WARNING: could not find nvidia.ko for kernel 5.15.0-89
systemd: Starting dracut initqueue hook...
dracut: Starting up: FAILED to find module nvidia
Kernel panic - not syncing: VFS: Unable to mount root fs
```

kai: that make.log line pretty telling — headers missing in the image. But why did rollback to 535 succeed for some nodes? maybe 535 module was prebuilt in initramfs/kernel package.

maria: we hit something like this earlier with 525->535 when dkms couldn't compile for older kernels and fallback modules existed. Also check 'lsmod | grep nouveau' in rescue — nouveau sometimes blocks nvidia build.

ashwin: I booted one node into rescue and ran:

```
apt-get install linux-headers-5.15.0-89-generic build-essential dkms
dkms status
# shows nvidia, 550.10, added but build failed
mokutil --sb-state
# SecureBoot enabled
```

kai: Secure Boot enabled. If modules aren't signed, kernel will refuse to load — that gives the missing symbols/errors. Options: 1) sign modules with our MOK and enroll, 2) disable Secure Boot for these images, or 3) prebuild modules and include in initramfs.

dave: any differences across regions? We saw similar flaky boots last month in eu-central when we ran 550 RC. Could be OEM kernel packaging differences on GCP vs self-hosted.

ashwin: affected nodes mostly in us-west1; eu-central had isolated failures but auto-recovered. We're seeing DKMS log lines: "ERROR: Cannot find module file nvidia.ko for kernel 5.15.0-89" which implies module build didn't create output — probably failed at compile flags or missing CUDA headers.

maria: also confirm glibc vs libnvidia compatibility. When kernel module fails but userspace libs are new (CUDA 12.1), processes hang with NCCL initializations failing. Are any training clusters impacted?

ashwin: We throttled scheduling on the pool. Two batch jobs saw NCCL errors and timed out. Notified SRE and queued a rollback for remaining nodes.

kai: short-term mitigation checklist: 
- cordon affected nodes
- boot one into rescue and apt-get linux-headers, build deps, run dkms autoinstall, sign modules if SB enabled
- rebuild initramfs after successful build: update-initramfs -u -k 5.15.0-89-generic
- re-image nodes with kernel-headers baked into custom image for 550 driver

ashwin: doing that. I'm also capturing outputs to /tmp/nvidia-550-dkms-logs.tar.gz and uploading to the incident bucket.

dave: long-term we should:
- include kernel-headers in our GPU node images (specific kernel pins per region)
- test driver+cuda+kernel matrix in staging (add H100/A100 variants) before fleet rollout
- add a preflight that checks 'dkms status' and attempts module build in a container during image rollout

maria: agreed. Also consider using NVIDIA precompiled modules package for known kernels where possible — reduces DKMS surface area. But watch for Secure Boot signatures.

node-health-bot: [alert] 5 nodes in us-west1-gpu reported boot-failure after driver upgrade at 2026-03-17T09:12:03Z. Auto-rollback started for 3 nodes.

kai: FYI I reproduced a signature rejection locally: dmesg shows "nvidia: module verification failed: signature and/or required key missing". If we sign modules, we need to ensure MOK is enrolled in node's UEFI. That has operational complexity for cloud images.

ashwin: I'll push a fastfix image with headers + signed modules for 5.15 kernels and coordinate a canary rollout to 3 nodes in us-west1. Will post results here.

maria: thanks. Also open a support ticket with NVIDIA — driver 550.x release notes mention kernel API changes that might break DKMS for older distro kernels.

ashwin: opened ticket #RDW-INF-3721 and attached logs. Rolling canary now.

kai: ping when canary passes or fails. If fails, plan B is to pin 535 across fleet and pause 550 rollout.

ashwin: canary passed for 3 nodes (2026-03-17T11:03:12Z) after we preinstalled headers and signed modules. Proceeding to batch of 15 with 10m delay.

maria: great. Postmortem checklist: kernel header inclusion in image, signed-module automation, canary gating in region-awareness, and adding a preflight DKMS build job in CI.

ashwin: noted. Will follow up with rollout summary and a short runbook.
